head: codex/5873-bounded-placement
title: [v0.92][WP-04.11] Bounded placement decisions
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5873

## Summary
- add deterministic bounded placement over committed membership and opaque verified capability/weather projections
- bind placement to service-owned time, current advertisement-signing certificates, and canonical membership trust-domain authority
- derive fencing eligibility from authoritative lease lineage transitions and complete fencing-store floors
- preserve valid same-epoch Fence to Activate to LeaseRenewal successors while rejecting stale, missing, or mismatched authority

## Validation
- focused distributed placement nextest: 16 passed, 0 skipped, 0 leaky
- strict focused Clippy with warnings denied: PASS
- canonical exact-revision receipt validator: PASS
- machine-derived negative cases: 13/13
- git diff hygiene: PASS

## Review
- independent exact-head review at 289badf00: PASS, no findings
- review covered the two owned product paths, canonical deep receipt, and final retained remediation proof

## Boundary
- distributed module registration remains owned by integration issue #5878
